purpose: Copy made for (eyācchayā) the brahmin Gaṅgādhara; book belongs to him.
notes: Catalogue scribe "Jayasiṃkarmmācārya" matches colophon (karmācārya Jayasiṃha). Date NS 799 agrees with catalogue; Mārgaśira kṛṣṇa 5, Friday. "vidyāpīṭhayā" is the scribe's location/institution (Newari genitive/locative), not a person; place of copying not certainly stated. Name "gaṃgā[dha]rarājasya" is flagged (!) and the bracketed syllable is an editorial restoration; "rāja" may be a title or part of the name. "eyācchayā" (Newari) is read as "for the sake of / at the wish of"; the exact sense is uncertain, so Gaṅgādhara is treated as owner/commissioner. Bhānudatta is the author of the text (Rasamañjarī), not part of this copy.
